content.text:
Finding submitted.

**LOL-CAP — deviation (fallback target).** Section 14.5 (p0602) is the Agreement's only limitation-of-liability provision: a mutual exclusion of special/consequential/incidental/punitive/indirect damages, with existing carve-outs for indemnification (Sections 14.1/14.2), confidentiality (Article XI) and IP (Article X). No aggregate monetary cap exists anywhere in the document — the only "exceed" ceiling is the $520,000,000 Milestone Payment limit in Section 9.2, and Section 14.6 confirms insurance creates no liability limit — so Sanofi's direct exposure (including for Research, Development, Manufacture and Commercialization) is unlimited. That fails the fallback element requiring a mutual cap based on 12 months of fees.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** one insert after Section 14.5 adding a mutual aggregate cap of fees paid or payable by Sanofi in the 12 months immediately preceding the claim, expressly subject to the preceding carve-out sentence and to gross negligence/willful misconduct. Indemnification and confidentiality are mapped as already met by the retained Section 14.5 language, so nothing is duplicated and no existing wording is disturbed.
